tasks.corrected_reference_answer: shade_rgb maps hsv, soft and overlay to bound blending methods; otherwise it calls blend_mode(rgb,intensity,**kwargs) (lib/matplotlib/colors.py:3726-3738). tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The embedding example creates one CanvasFrame during App.OnInit and enters the wx event loop (galleries/examples/user_interfaces/embedding_in_wx4_sgskip.py:70-79). material_errors: PaddedBox positions children before drawing frame; AnchoredOffsetbox draws frame before positioning child.
tasks.notes: Independent static inspection of pinned source; repository code was not executed. Scope is central claims, not exhaustive runtime verification.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: PaddedBox.draw computes bbox and child offsets, resolves parent offset, positions children, draws the frame, then draws children (lib/matplotlib/offsetbox.py:571-583). AnchoredOffsetbox computes its window extent, updates/draws its frame, then resolves offset and positions/draws the child (1085-1099). They share geometry and position consistently, but do not use one universal ordering.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: LatexManager._expect reads stdout one character at a time until the accumulated suffix matches the expected marker (lib/matplotlib/backends/backend_pgf.py:240-252). EOF kills the process, clears self.latex and raises LatexError. _expect_prompt uses newline-star (254-255). This synchronizes sequential command/response processing; it is not a thread-safety or race-freedom guarantee for concurrent users of the process.
